title: COMP Instance 2 Page
summary: Official Derivative common Instance 2 page reference for rotate-to-vector/up-vector instance attributes, instance/world transform order, texture coordinate mode, instance color mode, and instance texture controls.
guidance: Use this Instance 2 page card when a plan needs per-instance orientation, texture coordinates, colors, or textures after the basic Instance page mapping is set.
Rotate to Vector can be applied in default, pre-rotation, or post-rotation order, so choose the order that matches the transform equation you need.
Use Instance Order to decide whether instance transforms happen before or after the component world Xform/Pre-Xform pages.
Texture Mode replace swaps texture coordinates while transform offsets them; instanceu, instancev, and instancew interact with the SOP uv[0] layer.
Color Mode controls how instance color values combine with the SOP Cd attribute, using replace, multiply, add, or subtract modes.
